Activities: Engage Deaf and hard-of-hearing young people, youth-serving organizations, and safeguarding practitioners to review needs, user journeys, language, and safety risks. Identify possible pilot communities and referral services.
Outputs: Co-design notes; prioritized requirements; stakeholder and service-verification plan; draft consent and safeguarding procedures.
Milestone / Decision Gate: Month 2: Community and safeguarding review completed; pilot conditions documented.
Proposed measures: Complete at least two consultation rounds if partners and participant protections are in place; record and address safety concerns.

Activities: Refine SOS and check-in flows, Trusted Circle, Places, Digital Safety, and Personal Safety Plan. Review sensitive-data handling and strengthen storage protections before collecting real user data. Clarify offline, SMS, internet, and location requirements.
Outputs: Updated prototype; privacy and security review; verified service-directory draft; technical test plan.
Milestone / Decision Gate: Month 4: Prototype passes internal safety, privacy, and core-flow checks.
Proposed measures: Test core flows on supported devices; document unresolved privacy and reliability risks.

Activities: Run consent-based usability testing, including Deaf and hard-of-hearing users. Review English, Swahili, and Luganda translations with fluent speakers. Test text scaling, screen-reader navigation, SMS permissions, and intermittent-connectivity behavior.
Outputs: Accessibility and usability findings; reviewed translations; prioritized fixes; pilot-ready version; facilitator materials.
Milestone / Decision Gate: Month 6: Pilot readiness review completed with community and safeguarding input.
Proposed measures: Proposed usability target: at least 80% of test participants complete key tasks without assistance after revisions.

Activities: If partners and approvals are secured, run a limited pilot in one Ugandan community. Train facilitators; begin with scenario-based testing. Use live safety flows only with informed consent and appropriate safeguards, and provide clear routes to human support.
Outputs: Pilot summary; anonymized usability and reliability measures; documented incidents and mitigations; updated prototype.
Milestone / Decision Gate: Month 9: Decide whether the solution is safe and useful enough to continue, revise, or pause.
Proposed measures: Track task completion, accessibility feedback, SMS outcomes, and understanding of privacy limits; do not retain report contents for evaluation.

Activities: Review pilot results and partner feedback. Develop a maintenance plan, service-verification schedule, and funding and partnership proposals.
Outputs: Evaluation report; maintenance and safeguarding plan; partnership and funding proposals; next-phase budget.
Milestone / Decision Gate: Month 11: Community and technical review agrees on changes required before expansion.
Proposed measures: Set an evidence-based baseline and document costs, maintenance needs, and outstanding risks.

Activities: Prepare a lessons-learned summary that excludes personal case details. Confirm ownership, update responsibilities, costs, and partner capacity before considering another district.
Outputs: Version 1.0 roadmap; scale/no-scale decision; next-year plan and budget.
Milestone / Decision Gate: Month 12: Proceed only if safety, partner capacity, funding, and user feedback support expansion.
Proposed measures: Publish a next-phase plan with named owners, confirmed resources, and measurable targets.

Activities: Use data minimization, informed consent, safeguarding procedures, and clear limits on SMS confidentiality. Verify services before listing them and provide a way to remove outdated information.
Outputs: Documented consent and referral procedures; data-retention and deletion policy; service verification log.
Milestone / Decision Gate: Review safeguards at every decision gate; pause activities if a serious unresolved risk emerges.
Proposed measures: No personal report narratives or evidence in public evaluation; log and respond to safety incidents through an agreed protocol.
